note: Pipeline state for scripts/props-log.js: one prop per player per game, the side the board ranked on the last lines read before the start, graded from the box score. Never a price. Not loaded by the site.

seed.how: Every committed data/props.js replayed in order through lock() at the time it was written, then graded from ESPN box scores. Each prop is bestSide() of js/props-grade.js (as of the seeding commit) on the last committed lines read before its game started. Props of games not over at the seed were left pending, locked the same way, for the pipeline to grade.
